description: Lärmbelastungskataster für Haupt- und übrige Strassen is a series of datasets listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Zürich. Strassenlärmbelastungskataster für Haupt- und übrige Strassen. Basierend auf Geobasisdatenmodel (GeoIV, Anhang 1, Identifikator 144). Für Lärmgutachten geeignete Daten finden sich hier. Zweck: Veröffentlichen von Daten gemäss Bundesgesetz vom 5. Oktober 2007 über Geoinformation (GeoIG, SR 510.62) und Verordnung vom 21. Mai 2008 über Geoinformation (GeoIV, SR 510.620). Coverage: Stadt Zürich. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Stadt Zürich. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, DXF, GPKG, JSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
